description.value: Arigato Sushi is a fusion Japanese restaurant in Kamloops' Aberdeen neighbourhood, known for creative sushi rolls and consistently praised service. The casual, booth-filled dining room has earned a loyal local following for both lunch and dinner visits. Takeout and catering are available, making it a flexible stop for cyclists passing through Kamloops.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website was successfully fetched and confirms Arigato Sushi is an active fusion sushi restaurant at #70-1395 Hillside Dr, Kamloops, with phone 250-314-1185. The website explicitly lists 'To go' and 'Order' options confirming takeout service. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or any cycling-specific amenities was found in the website content.
concerns: Website page title reads 'Arigato Sushi Aberdeen' while OSM name is 'Arigato Sushi' — Aberdeen likely refers to the Aberdeen neighbourhood in Kamloops, not a separate location, but worth verifying.
Website testimonials section contains Lorem ipsum placeholder text (three 'John Doe CEO' entries) mixed with real customer reviews, suggesting the site was never fully completed.
OSM record has no address or phone; both were sourced entirely from the website and cannot be cross-checked against OSM data.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active sit-down and takeout restaurant in Kamloops with confirmed address and phone; a useful food stop for touring cyclists, pending confirmation of bike parking.

wow_evidence: earned a loyal local following for both lunch and dinner visits
